item.title: Introducing Our New Chatbot Powered by Go's Expr for Dynamic Logic.
item.description: TurboHey is our chatbot engine to visually create rich conversational flows using boxes and Go’s Expr language, with our tool is easy to implement complex things like ‘premium chats’ where only certain parts of the flow are accessible after payment, or to recommend products to clients based on their local time zone and the weather.

item.title: Unveiling the secrets of Unreal Engine memory systems
item.description: We’re working on the ultimate, illustrated guide to the MallocBinned2 allocator inside Unreal Engine. Learn the low-level strategies that MB2 uses to manage memory, including its binning system and caching mechanisms, to gain a superior understanding of Unreal’s runtime performance.

item.title: The Unscripted Journey of Building a Chatbot
item.description:
Hello and welcome to our newest project TurboHey!

Today marks the official beginning of a project we’ve been wanting to tackle for a long time: building a custom chatbot from the ground up. This first post is all about setting the stage and clarifying our central goal: making conversational AI easy and accessible for everyday business.

item.title: Our community blog to share technical knowledge
item.description: We created RawSourceCode, a techcnical blog to share deep-dive technical analyses and illustrated overviews of complex topics, with a strong emphasis on game development, low-level programming, cloud infraestructure and other interesing programming topics.

item.title: Our interactive plugin to create a realsensing perspective illusion
item.description: HoloCam Webcam is a highly customizable Plug & Play plugin for Windows 10 that uses your webcam to track your player face and modify the perspective inside your scenes to achieve real-sensing 3D.
